about: Sherven Sales, Inc. was founded in 1970 and has remained a family-owned and operated business in Wahpeton, North Dakota, for over five decades. The company specializes in grain systems, grain handling equipment, livestock equipment, and trailers, providing assembly and service for all products it sells. Its offerings cover grain bins and handling equipment, livestock feeding and handling equipment, and flatbed, enclosed, and stock trailers. The business combines product sales with hands-on assembly and ongoing service support, serving both new installations and existing equipment maintenance. Sherven Sales serves agricultural operations that require grain storage and handling systems, livestock producers needing feeding and handling equipment, and transport operations using flatbed, enclosed, and stock trailers. The company’s focus on assembly and service aims to support customers throughout the equipment lifecycle, from initial installation to maintenance and repair. The company distinguishes itself by offering assembly and service on every product line it carries, allowing customers to source equipment and installation from a single provider, a model rooted in its family-owned commitment to long-term customer relationships.
